comment: Independent C-first lawful Priest with mention_map and the time option. A ring of warning shows the Valley of the Dead's moving undead as warning glyphs on unexplored squares, and display.c show_glyph() reports each through pline_xy() while that monster is still moving. Each notice's vpline() flush therefore shows the turn counter before allmain.c moveloop_core() advances it: the first --More-- (step 37) shows T:3. Independent seed, clock, role and route.
